summary: Appeal from Allahabad High Court's dismissal of writ petition challenging District Registrar/Additional Collector order to register a sale deed; facts involve land at 110-B Civil Lines, Bareilly; two agreements to sell with Gujral Associates; alleged fraud, misrepresentation, and coercion; Sub-Registrar refused registration; District Registrar allowed appeal; issues include whether the sale deed was validly executed/registrable under the Indian Registration Act; statutory framework analyzed: sections 72 and 74 of the Registration Act 1908, section 35(3)A of the Indian Registration Act, and Rule 249 of the Registration Manual, Part-2; analysis centers on meaning of execution and validity of alleged forged document and recourse under the Registration Act.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 35(3)A of the Indian Registration Act
Rule 249 of the Registration Manual, Part-2
